description: Northern  Provincial Council - Notifying Supplementary  Provisions for Appropriation Statute, No. 05 of 2017
categorisation: This gazette content enacts a provincial statute (Supplementary Provision for Appropriation Statute No. 05 of 2017) that provides legal authority for supplementary financial provisions and expenditure reallocations for the Northern Provincial Council. It establishes a legal framework for budgetary matters, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
